result: Added frontend account and audit data models/components in src/FactorioManager.Web/src/App.tsx and extended /api/auth/me to expose uid/name/role for owner-aware UI. Accounts supports owner account listing, create admin/viewer, and confirmed deletion; audit screen supports bounded newest-first pagination and outcome display. Existing navigation now includes Accounts and Audit entries. API gap: password reset and role-change controls are not yet wired into the account row, and the large existing App return expression prevented clean insertion of the new tab render branches during this slice.

evidence.outcome: now returns csrfToken, uid, name, and role

next_slice.summary: Wire Accounts/Audit components into App tab rendering and add role/password controls plus explicit non-owner forbidden handling.

blockers: New Accounts and AuditLog components are defined but their render branches still need insertion into the existing one-line App return expression.
